about: Enrol in the Dubai fellowship training for doctors with a general specialty board certificate. For healthcare professionals only.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Only for healthcare professionals (doctors, dentists, nurses and similar), not for patients or the general public
For doctors who finished residency and hold a general specialty board certificate
Registration opens only when the programme announces it
documents: Passport, and Emirates ID and residence permit if applicable
English test result from the last 2 years if applicable
Two recommendation letters dated within a year
CV, valid professional licence and internship certificate
Degree and transcript with notarised English translation if needed
fees: AED 620 in total, made up of registration, review, Knowledge and Innovation fees
timing: 2 months after registration closes and all requirements are complete
